title: 第六章 高考

content_zh:
“考江南第一军校，十拿九稳。”
这就是罗峰心中想法。
※※※※※※
六月七号，这是高考第一天。华夏国的高考时间为六月七八九号三天，跟大涅盘时期之前的高考日子一样。
宜安区第一高中。
按照考场安排，本是三中学生的罗峰，高考就是在这第一高中进行。
“女儿，加油。”
“放心吧，老爸。”
“甜甜，别给自己太大压力啊。”
第一高中校门外，聚集了密密麻麻大量的高考考生和家长，而在第一高中的校门口外，也站着一排手持真枪实弹的警察。
“小峰啊，考试的时候心态要放松。咱们家就算上不了第一军校，上第二军校也行的。轻松点！”父亲罗洪国看着自己儿子，笑呵呵说道。
“嗯。”罗峰笑着点头。
“滴——滴——”随着响亮的车鸣声，只见一辆全身幽黑，充满着贵族气质的最新款的奔驰s600，在一辆辆警用机车的护拥下缓缓驶向第一高中的大门，周围的考生家长立即朝旁边避让，一个个目光都聚集在那辆车上。
最新款奔驰s600，加速到时速一百，只需要一秒六，极限速度达到时速500公里。当然这点性能不算什么，奔驰s600作为从大涅盘时期就传下来的品牌，其本身的历史底蕴才是最吸引人的。
只见奔驰s600走下来三人，彼此谈笑着朝校门口走去。
“左边的秃头，就是咱们宜安区的警察局张局长啊。”
“右边的那个，是教育局的刘主任吧。”
“中间的，那一定是负责考场安全总指挥的武者。”只见考场外大量家长、考生们议论纷纷，绝大多数人目光都聚集在那中央一人身上，目光中蕴含着兴奋、崇拜、好奇。
现如今人类和怪兽的战斗，是一直在持续的。
而普通人是禁止离开市区边界的，而武者们，就是能够一对一和怪兽厮杀的存在。整个人类社会对于武者们，也是非常感激的，感激他们为人类作出那么大的贡献。普通人们自然一个个很崇拜武者。

武者，属于人类群体中地位超然的一群人。
“那就是武者啊。”父亲罗洪国也看着那人，“每次高考的考场安全总指挥，都是请武者担当。”
“武者。”
罗峰看过去，那名武者有一种让人看了就心悸的感觉，他的眼睛也好似毒蛇森冷的眸子，一路上不苟言笑。面对那警察局局长和教育局的刘主任，这名武者只是时而淡然点点头，根本懒得理会。
“在不远的将来，我也会获得武者称号！”罗峰心中默默道。
“卡卡～～～”
第一高中的大门缓缓“进场了。”立即传来一阵阵声音。
“小峰，进场了。你快进去吧。”父亲罗洪国连道，旁边母亲龚心兰也连道：“快去吧，妈等会儿就回去给你烧饭，你爸和弟弟在这等你考完。”
“嗯。”
罗峰微笑点点头。
“哥。”弟弟罗华坐在轮椅上，向罗峰竖起了自己的拳头，微微一笑，“一定要加油啊！”
“加油。”罗峰也竖起拳头。
随即罗峰转头在考生人群当中一起，经过检查，一一通过了校门口。
※※※※※※
考场教室内，考试证和身份证放在桌子右上角供考官检查，而试卷则开始发了下来。
“2056年江南市高考理科试卷A卷”——试卷的最上面清楚的一行字。
“第一场是理科考试！”
看着面前的试卷，罗峰目光一扫，又看了看最后的几条大题目，似乎是曾相识，“这次题目应该不算难，题目不难的话。我理科的优势就很难发挥出来，只能小心认真的做题，尽量做到会做的不丢分。”
罗峰当即开始埋头去写。
高考一共有三场考试，分别是理科考试、文科考试以及最后的数学考试。每门满分都是250分，总分满分是750分。

理科是指物理、化学、生物三门综合。
文科是值语文、历史、政治、地理四门综合。
数学考试，自然就是数学一门。
人类大涅盘时期之后，特别是人类和怪兽的战斗持续不断，让人类拼命在科技、武道上研究。这令大家更加清晰的感觉到‘数学’的重要。任何一个想要在计算机、生物、物理等领域要获得大成就的，都需要坚实的数学基础。

content_en:
"Take the exam at the Jiangnan First Military Academy, and you're a sure shot."
This is what Luo Feng is thinking.
※※※※※※
June 7th is the first day of the college entrance examination. The college entrance examination in Huaxia Kingdom is held on June 7th and 89th for three days, which is the same as the college entrance examination before the Great Nirvana period.
The first high school in Yi'an District.
According to the examination room arrangement, Luo Feng, who was originally a student of No. 3 Middle School, took the college entrance examination at No. 1 High School.
"Daughter, come on."
"Don't worry, Dad."
"Tiantian, don't put too much pressure on yourself."
Outside the gate of No. 1 High School, a large number of college entrance examination candidates and parents gathered. And outside the gate of No. 1 High School, there was also a row of police officers holding live ammunition.
"Xiao Feng, you should relax during the exam. Even if our family can't go to the First Military Academy, we can go to the Second Military Academy. Just relax!" Father Luo Hongguo looked at his son and said with a smile.
"Yeah." Luo Feng smiled and nodded.
"Beep - beep -" With the loud sound of the car, a black, latest Mercedes-Benz S600 full of aristocratic temperament was seen, escorted by police motorcycles, slowly driving towards the gate of the No. 1 High School. The parents of the surrounding candidates immediately moved aside, and all their eyes were focused on the car.
The latest Mercedes-Benz S600 accelerates to a speed of 100 kilometers per hour in only one second and six, and the top speed reaches 500 kilometers per hour. Of course, this performance is nothing. As a brand passed down from the Great Nirvana period, the Mercedes-Benz S600's own historical heritage is the most attractive.
I saw three people getting out of the Mercedes-Benz S600, talking and laughing with each other and walking towards the school gate.
"The bald man on the left is Director Zhang of the Yi'an District Police Department."
"The one on the right is Director Liu from the Education Bureau."
"The one in the middle must be the warrior who is in charge of the safety of the examination room." A large number of parents and candidates were seen talking about it outside the examination room. Most people's eyes were focused on the person in the middle, with excitement, admiration, and curiosity in their eyes.
Nowadays, the battle between humans and monsters is ongoing.
Ordinary people are prohibited from leaving the city limits, but warriors are the ones who can fight monsters one-on-one. The entire human society is also very grateful to the warriors for their great contributions to mankind. Ordinary people naturally admire warriors.
Warriors belong to a group of people with a transcendent status in the human community.
"That's the warrior." His father, Luo Hongguo, also looked at that person. "Every time the college entrance examination is conducted, a warrior is appointed as the overall security commander."
"Warrior."
Luo Feng looked over and saw that the warrior had a feeling that made people feel palpitated just by looking at him. His eyes were like the cold eyes of a poisonous snake, and he was unsmiling all the way. Facing the police chief and Director Liu of the Education Bureau, the warrior just nodded indifferently from time to time and didn't bother to pay attention.
"In the near future, I will also receive the title of warrior!" Luo Feng said silently in his heart.
"Kaka~~~"
The gate of No. 1 High School slowly "entered." Immediately there was a burst of sound.
"Xiao Feng, it's time to enter. Come in quickly," his father Luo Hongguo said, and his mother Gong Xinlan said next to him, "Go quickly. Mom will go back and cook for you later. Your father and brother are here waiting for you to finish the exam."
"Yeah."
Luo Feng smiled and nodded.
"Brother." His younger brother Luo Hua sat in a wheelchair, raised his fist to Luo Feng, and smiled slightly, "You must work hard!"
"Come on." Luo Feng also raised his fist.
Luo Feng then turned around and joined the crowd of candidates. After inspection, they passed through the school gate one by one.
※※※※※※
In the examination room classroom, the examination certificate and ID card were placed on the upper right corner of the table for the examiner to check, and the test papers began to be distributed.
"2056 Jiangnan City College Entrance Examination Science Paper A" - the clear line at the top of the paper.
"The first one is the science exam! "
Looking at the test paper in front of him, Luo Feng glanced at the last few big questions, as if he had known them before, "The questions this time should not be difficult. If the questions are not difficult. It is difficult for me to bring my advantages in science into full play. I can only do the questions carefully and conscientiously, and try my best to do it as well as possible without losing points. "
Luo Feng immediately began to immerse himself in writing.
There are three examinations in the college entrance examination, namely science examination, liberal arts examination and the final mathematics examination. The full score for each subject is 250 points, and the total score is 750 points.
Science refers to the combination of physics, chemistry and biology.
Liberal arts is a comprehensive study of four subjects: Chinese, history, politics, and geography.
The mathematics test is naturally mathematics.
After the Great Nirvana period of mankind, especially the continuous battle between humans and monsters, humans desperately researched in technology and martial arts. This makes everyone feel more clearly the importance of ‘mathematics’. Anyone who wants to achieve great achievements in the fields of computers, biology, physics, etc. needs a solid mathematical foundation.
